details.description: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct is the smallest model in Meta's Llama 3.2 collection, released September 25, 2024, with about 1.23 billion parameters and a 128K-token context window (8K when quantized). It's an instruction-tuned, text-only, multilingual model built for lightweight assistant-style chat, agentic retrieval, summarization, and on-device or edge deployment, with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. Amazon Bedrock's current model card lists this model's lifecycle status as Legacy, with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date.
advantages: SpinQuant and QLoRA quantized variants cut model size by 52-54% and roughly double decode speed for on-device deployment, per Meta's model card.
Officially supports 8 languages: English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai.
disadvantages: Text-only; no image, audio, or video input or output.
Amazon Bedrock's model card lists client-side tool calling as not supported for this model.
Marked Legacy on Amazon Bedrock's model card, with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date.
use_cases: On-device deployment on mobile and other resource-constrained hardware.

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date is empty for this target, but Amazon Bedrock's own model card marks this model's lifecycle status as Legacy with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026, already past as of the 2026-09-24 research date. Catalog's max_output_tokens (4096) matches Bedrock's listed 4K max output. Meta's own llama.com/developer.meta.com model-card pages redirected to a login screen and could not be read directly, so this write-up relies on Meta's GitHub and Hugging Face model cards plus AWS Bedrock's status page.
